propositions: Jira Data Center built-in rate limiting (token bucket, per-user, admin-enabled) is not honoured by rebar; a 429 response propagates as a hard failure on first occurrence instead of being retried.
429 retry logic cannot be added to transport.py in-place because the file is locked at 800 lines with only 11 lines of headroom remaining.

Retrying 429s through _with_connection_retry (the single choke point for all 15 transport call sites including create_issue) would reintroduce the duplicate-issue defect because a 429 can arrive after the server has begun a write.
429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via a per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF; all mutations must fail fast on 429 to avoid duplicates.
Retry-After header must be parsed with jitter (up to 20% random) applied first and then clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S (60 seconds), using the value from exc.response.headers not exc.headers.
